title: Agency
description: A federal law enforcement agency's application (M4.3, D154): what it asks, and each stage's chance and wait, traced to CALIBRATION.md (tune where marked there).

requires.description: What an application asks: a bachelor's, an age, and years of professional work, fewer with an advanced degree.

least.description: The youngest age that may apply.

most.description: The oldest age that may apply.

careers.description: Careers whose work counts as professional experience.

minutes.description: Minutes worked in them that an application asks.

advanced.description: Minutes asked of one with an advanced degree (a JD).

written.description: The written test: minutes it takes, its pass rate with no study, the points an hour of study adds, the most, and the days from applying until it can be sat.

perHour.description: Points an hour of study adds.

fitness.description: The fitness test: passing with no training and with the hours of training it asks, in proportion between, and the days from the written test.

full.description: Passing, in 100, with the hours it asks.

interview.description: The interview: its pass rate, minutes and the days from the fitness test.

background.description: The polygraph and background investigation: its pass rate, less for any conviction, and the days it takes.

again.description: Days after a refusal before applying again.

trainee.description: The career one cleared reports to: the Academy's, whose ladder leads to the agent's (M4.3 step 2, D157).

cases.description: An agent's cases (M4.3 step 3, D159): one at a time, against a rival crew's head or the supplier's crew; evidence from the work, then an indictment at a chance from it.

corners.description: Corners whose holders an agent can open a case on: yours and the first after it.

least.description: Evidence before an indictment can be asked for.

most.description: The highest chance an indictment holds, in 100: the chance is the evidence, up to this.

sentence.description: Days a crew's head is away, convicted.
Days the supplier's crew is away, convicted: nobody sells to you.
